a plan past ar_plan_terms (max_installments/max_term_days, defaults 3/90, P-193 row) throws PlanPastThresholdException before any write; the builder shows the financing-partner waiting state (G1-61, G1-70, N-033). Test: PaymentplanBuilderScreenTest

the reason rule is a gate, not a sort: recordReason writes ar_dunning_actions (reason_recorded) and a disputed line or a complaint escalates — escalate_to_human row, receivable_states escalated, ArEscalatedToHuman — so the invoice never enters a reminder sequence (§216.3, §216.5, N-033). Test: InvoiceThreadBesideScreenTest

collections is a human action: ar_collections_packages row (RLS) records packaged_by_user_id and the evidence bundle; it is built only after a recorded resolution attempt (R211 — a reason, a plan or a payment, NoResolutionAttemptException before any write); transmission is a finished waiting state until a partner is named (G1-65, N-033). Test: CollectionsPackagePreviewScreenTest

terms are a closed set (due_on_receipt, net_15, net_30, net_60) and a limit is never negative: TermsSetAction refuses with InvalidTermsException before any write, and a null card token means keep, never blank — the overflow rule charges that card (§46A, G1-33). Test: CreditsScreenTest

MRR on this screen is the row this account contributes: the agreed price on the subscription row (3443) plus extra locations, a yearly term shown as a twelfth, never the registry figure (3444); the cross-account roll-up is a finished waiting state until an operator read path exists (OWNER ACTION 15, G9-31). Test: MrrScreenTest

revenue recovery counts what came back after the ladder started: top-ups and grants dated from the dunning row's creation, against the agreed monthly value at risk; the phone answers on every rung and the ladder never resets from this screen — BillingLedgerEngine is Track 1's (§45A, G9-31, G1-19, G1-28, R211). Test: RevenueRecoveryScreenTest

X-198 — a discrepancy is reviewed, never corrected: reconciliation_runs carries reviewed_at/reviewed_by_user_id, GatewayEngine::reviewDiscrepancy refuses a balanced run (NothingToReviewException) and is idempotent on a reviewed one, the numbers on the run are never written again; the screen lists discrepancy_logged runs only and the cross-account roll-up is a finished waiting state (OWNER ACTION 15, X-198 anchor). Test: ReconciliationDiscrepanciesScreenTest

X-198 — same account is the account's own proof: per connection where money lands, the payments and payouts that landed there and the last reconciliation; a detached payment (connection row gone) attaches to one of this account's connections once — GatewayEngine::attachPayment refuses a payment that already lands somewhere (PaymentAlreadyLandedException), a payment is never moved (§134.1, X-198 anchor); pulling payouts is a finished waiting state until the gateway exposes a payout read. Test: SameAccountScreenTest

X-201 — a dispute is never submitted empty: DisputeDefenseEngine::submit refuses unless the bundle is compiled (DisputeNotCompiledException), the queue compiles the invoice line plus the tenant's note, the outcome is a closed set (won/lost) through DisputeOutcomeAction and a loss records the clawback; evidence from telephony and signature capture and the deadline from the gateway's webhook are finished waiting states (G1-08, X-201 anchor). Test: DisputeQueueScreenTest

X-201 — the tenant's card: the bundle compiles itself and the tenant adds what only they know — DisputeNoteAction compiles the invoice line with the first note and the note alone after; DisputeDefenseEngine::compile refuses a submitted, won or lost dispute (DisputeAlreadySubmittedException) because a submitted bundle is sealed; approval submits through DisputeSubmitAction; there is no refund verb on the card (N-010) and the deadline is a finished waiting state on the gateway's chargeback webhook (N-011, §156.3). Test: DisputeCardScreenTest

X-120 — the vault's door takes the number, the expiry and the name and keeps none of them: CardPresentAction checks Luhn, the month, the expiry and the name, derives brand and last four, writes no row, dispatches no event and logs nothing, and answers waiting_on_tokenisation; the screen clears the number in a finally so it is never round-tripped, and the finished state is 'Waiting on Stripe tokenisation' until Stripe Elements or a tokenisation contract exists; the security code has no field of any name (N-046, N-047, N-120-01, P-196, ruling 20/21). Test: CardScreenTest::test_card_door_takes_number_expiry_and_name_stores_nothing_and_never_shows_the_number_again

X-117 — the cart block is the catalogue and the cart, customer-facing behind tenancy: CheckoutEngine::addToCart refuses more than the stock (SoldOutException, before any write), reads inventory and writes only the cart row — stock comes off at paid, never at cart (§147.2); the countdown is the row's expires_at, never moved by render, add or remove, restarted only when a cart is new or expired (G16-05); prices are read from sellables, never written; Check out is a finished waiting state on the checkout block, where every charge takes a fresh authorisation (G1-15). Test: CartBlockScreenTest

X-117 — the checkout block is the fresh-authorisation door: CheckoutEngine::checkoutCart refuses a missing, expired_ or ALREADY-USED authorisation (an orders.auth_token match — G1-15, G1-39: a second charge on a stored token with no new consent is refused), an empty or expired cart, and any short line before anything is written; then one order, N lines, stock off at paid (§147.2), the cart row deleted, InventoryUpdated per line; a tap on Authorise mints the authorisation event and pay() clears it in a finally so it is never round-tripped; cancel reverses stock through OrderCancelAction; the card is never asked for here (P-160) and the capture through the gateway is a finished waiting state. Test: CheckoutBlockScreenTest

X-173 — the conflicts list is where a person closes a sync conflict and the only place: AccountingSyncEngine::resolveConflict answers status refused for a blank or 'uncategorised' answer (posting to uncategorised is not a resolution) and for a resolved row (a resolution is not overwritten silently), status resolved otherwise — an array answer, not an exception, is the module's shape; the sync path never calls it, so a conflict row is never auto-closed (anchor, §141.5); no event — a person's decision is not an inference; sync.conflict (§141.5) is absent from the generated manifest, UNRESOLVED on Track 1's scaffold. Test: ConflictsListScreenTest

X-173 — the connection-mapping screen: AccountingSyncEngine::mapAccount maps one category to one ledger account per connection (updateOrCreate keyed on business, connection, category — a remap replaces, never duplicates; §30.5 reviewed once then automatic), refuses a blank part and an inactive or foreign connection with a status refused answer; AccountingMapAction delegates and returns that array (X173Test reads no return); the OAuth connect is a finished waiting state that writes no row — a connection with a made-up token is a guess (§141.5 never guesses silently); QuickBooks/Xero/Sage credentials are UNRESOLVED (owner). Test: ConnectionMappingScreenTest

X-173 — the sync error rate counts every line the run saw: AccountingSyncEngine::rateOf is conflicts over records_synced + conflicts_count and null — 'nothing to sync', never a healthy 0% — when nothing was seen; errorRate(businessId, runId) reads a run and delegates to it; the overall line is rateOf over the tenant's sums (§30.5 a failed line is a dead letter not a silent gap; the tracker's UNKNOWN-not-STALE invariant); a run's conflicts open under its row in-page because routing is Track 1's. Test: SyncErrorRateScreenTest

X-199 — paid today is the recorded payment time: invoices.paid_at (nullable, indexed) is stamped by InvoiceEngine::recordPayment in the same write that sets status paid, and MoneyPaidToday reads and orders by it — an old paid invoice edited today is not paid today, and a paid row with null paid_at predates the column and is not counted; the screen reads, it never writes (§58.4). Test: MoneyPaidTodayScreenTest

the late-fee term is a ROW on ar_plan_terms — late_fee_percent and late_fee_cap_cents, nullable, beside the plan threshold; null means the agreement names no late fee and ArEngine::applyLateFee throws FeeWithoutTermException before any write (G1-71); the percent and the cap replace the engine's 10 % / $50 literal (P-193). Rejected: a per-invoice term column (the agreement is the tenant's terms; X-121's quote is Track 1's spine, ruling 8); keeping the literal (P-193); a caller-supplied hasTerm flag (ruling 15 — a refusal clause is not a refusal). Consequence: a tenant with no term written gets no late fee until the owner writes one. Test: X211Test::test_a_fee_with_no_matching_term_is_refused
